Allocation for various investor categories has been defined, with shares listing expected on September 18.

title: Maruti Suzuki is top Nifty 50 loser today - what's driving the fall?
summary: Shares of Maruti Suzuki India opened at  ₹13,540 against its previous close of  ₹13,547 and dropped 5.1% to an intraday low of  ₹12,851. Around 1:15 PM, the stock was 4.7% down at  ₹12,915, trading as the top loser in the Nifty 50 index.

title: Manufacturing PMI slips to five-year low: Is more pain in store?
summary: Declining PMI momentum, coupled with margin risks and potential capex cuts, suggests the economy faces a trickier second half despite strong Q1 growth.

title: Oil companies set for earnings recovery in Q2 despite uncertainty
summary: Lower crude oil prices and easing freight and insurance costs should support a swift recovery for oil marketing companies and likely compensate for Q1 losses.

title: Jewellery stocks down: Why Kalyan Jewellers, Titan, Augmont and others are losing sheen today? What's driving the fall?
summary: Shares of Kalyan Jewellers plunged as much as 7% in intraday deals, while those of Augmont Enterprises crashed 6% on the BSE. Other jewellery stocks, such as PC Jeweller and Titan Company, declined 2% each during the sessions.

title: Meesho wants its small sellers to graduate from merchants to brands
summary: As smaller, less-experienced sellers flood the platform, Meesho is using AI to simplify online selling, push merchants towards brands and expand into grocery without abandoning its value proposition.

title: Whatfix co-founder Khadim Batti passes away
summary: Whatfix co-founder and CEO Khadim Batti helped build the SaaS startup into a global enterprise software company valued at nearly $900 million.

title: ArcelorMittal drops takeover of Italy JV after government ruling
summary: ArcelorMittal SA dropped its planned takeover of a joint venture with struggling carpart manufacturer CLN-Coils Lamiere Nastri SpA after the Italian government imposed restrictions, paving the way for a domestic rival to take control.

title: UBL sees premium beer growing 3x faster than market
summary: United Breweries has made a  ₹110 crore investment in a new canning facility, aiming to boost production of Kingfisher and other premium brands despite rising input costs.

title: Real dairy cream for  ₹10: Reliance enters India’s ice cream market with Bombay Creamery
summary: Reliance Consumer Products Limited has launched Bombay Creamery, its new premium ice cream brand in India. The brand features real dairy ingredients and a diverse product range starting at  ₹10.

title: WeWork India inks managed office lease deal with Cognizant in Chennai
summary: WeWork India has leased 141,392 sq ft to Cognizant in Chennai. The deal highlights IT firms’ growing use of flexible workspaces alongside long-term leases.

title: Oracle layoffs: Software company likely to cut 3,000 jobs in India. Where is the money moving?
summary: Oracle layoffs could impact up to to 10,000 employees globally, including 3,000 in India alone ahead of September quarter. Is the software company redirecting spending towards its AI infrastructure push?

title: Sun Pharma signs deal with US government to reduce drug prices
summary: Sun Pharma has committed to applying MFN pricing to future innovative medicine launches and will also avoid tariffs on innovative pharmaceutical products for more than two years.

title: Eureka Forbes: CCPA flags 5,008 complaints about service lapses, deceptive claims; fines company  ₹5 lakh
summary: India’s top consumer watchdog has directed the water-purifier market leader to ensure genuine spare parts, make its maintenance contracts more transparent, and fix grievance resolution after national helpline data exposed hidden terms and allegedly misleading claims.

title: Unacademy’s $3.44 billion valuation to $200 million acquisition by upGrad: Gaurav Munjal reflects on journey
summary: Edtech company upGrad has completed its acquisition of Unacademy for just over $200 million, far below the latter's peak $3.44 billion valuation. Unacademy co-founder Gaurav Munjal said the deal will benefit the education ecosystem, while highlighting Unacademy’s impact on online learning in India.

title: IPO-bound Parle Products appoints former PepsiCo executive George Kovoor as CEO
summary: Kovoor spent over 30 years at PepsiCo across geographies, including China and the US, before serving as senior vice president and general manager of its India beverages business.

title: AdvaRisk in talks to raise $20-25 million from Fundamentum, others
summary: ICICI Bank-backed AdvaRisk is exploring a $20-25 million fundraise as banks step up efforts to detect fraud and recover stressed assets.

summary: The 8th pay commission has scheduled state visits to Chennai, Puducherry, Chandigarh, Bengaluru and Mumbai in September and October 2026. Here's the full list of dates and who can participate in the meetings.

title: FAST-DS 2026: Form 1 live on income tax portal for foreign asset disclosure; check eligibility, filing process
summary: Form 1 is now live on the income tax e-filing portal for the Foreign Assets of Small Taxpayers Disclosure Scheme, 2026. This one-time scheme allows eligible taxpayers to disclose foreign assets and income. Declarations can be filed until 31 December 2026.

title: DA news: Employees criticise transfer of key leader, BJP and Congress attack Punjab CM, govt may move SC—See top updates
summary: Punjab transferred Sukhchain Singh Khera, key member of the state employees' protest, where over 150 employees' bodies and more than 3.50 lakh pensioners participated in one of the biggest mobilisations against the government.

title: High-yield bonds pay more, but there’s a catch: Who should invest and how much risk can you take?
summary: High-yield bonds offer higher interest income but carry greater credit, default and liquidity risks than highly rated debt. Experts explain who should consider these bonds, what investors should check and how much exposure may be appropriate.

title: Finfluencers are shaping investment choices. How can investors separate advice from noise?
summary: Finfluencers increasingly shape Indian investment decisions, but few are Sebi-registered. Here’s what investors should know about stock calls, sponsorships, credentials, red flags and recourse.

title: Pledged your life insurance policy for a bank loan? NCDRC says lender can surrender it without consent
summary: The NCDRC has ruled on a case involving an LIC policy assigned as security for a bank loan, holding that the insurer was not deficient in acting on the bank's surrender request. Here's what the order means for policyholders who use insurance policies as loan collateral.

title: High-yield investments can hide a catch. Here’s what income investors should know
summary: Dividend stocks, Reits and InvITs can offer attractive payouts, but investors need to look beyond yield to cash flows, capital preservation, taxes and total returns.

title: PPF real return is more than 7.1%: Here's the calculation most investors miss
summary: PPF offers 7.1% interest, but eligible old-regime taxpayers may earn a higher effective return after factoring in the Section 80C tax benefit. Here’s how the tax saving can push the effective annualised return to around 11%, and why the benefit does not apply to every investor.

title: DA hike: CPI-IW rises to 153.2; is 64% DA likely for central govt employees? Here’s what the calculation shows
summary: July 2026 CPI-IW rose 1.3 points to 153.2, taking the running DA calculation for central government employees to about 64% for January 2027. The final DA rate will depend on CPI-IW data for August to December 2026 and the government's formal announcement.

title: Hugging Face's new duck robot is selling fast. A Chinese chip powers it
summary: The colorful "Microduck" robot from HuggingFace's French subsidiary Pollen Robotics has sold more than 10,000 units since launching on Thursday.
